name: Chaser Pro

origin.basis: Shandong Jiluer Tire Co., Tengzhou, Shandong (brand directory).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Light folding race clincher from a Shandong tire maker, sold in China as a low-cost alternative to premium race tires.
weight_basis: One owner weighed a 28C at 216 g.

community.summary: Light at 216 g (28C) for CNY 140; note the reversed rotation arrow.
Bulges and ply separation after about 2,400 km on one tire.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; no official JILUER store was found.

price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: One owner report describes bulging and ply separation; inspect the casing regularly.
